verses.am: ከማያምኑ ሰዎች አንዱም ቢጠራችሁ ልትሄዱም ብትወዱ ከሕሊና የተነሣ ሳትመራመሩ የሚያቀርቡላችሁን ሁሉ ብሉ።

verses.en: But if any man say unto you, this is offered in sacrifice unto idols, eat not for his sake that shewed it, and for conscience sake: for the earth is the Lord's, and the fulness thereof:
verses.fr: Mais si quelqu''un vous dit: Ceci a été offert en sacrifice! n''en mangez pas, à cause de celui qui a donné l''avertissement, et à cause de la conscience.
verses.am: ማንም ግን። ይህ ለጣዖት የተሠዋ ነው ቢላችሁ ከዚያ ካስታወቃችሁና ከሕሊና የተነሣ አትብሉ፤

verses.en: Conscience, I say, not thine own, but of the other: for why is my liberty judged of another man's conscience?
verses.fr: Je parle ici, non de votre conscience, mais de celle de l''autre. Pourquoi, en effet, ma liberté serait-elle jugée par une conscience étrangère?
verses.am: ስለ ባልንጀራህ ሕሊና እንጂ ስለ ገዛ ሕሊናህ አልናገርም። አርነቴ በሌላ ሰው ሕሊና የሚፈርድ Avረ ስለ ምንድር ነው?

verses.en: For if I by grace be a partaker, why am I evil spoken of for that for which I give thanks?
verses.fr: Si je mange avec actions de grâces, pourquoi serais-je blâmé au sujet d''une chose dont je rends grâces?
verses.am: እኔም በጸጋ ብበላ፥ በነገሩ ስለማመሰግንበት ስለ ምን እሰደባለሁ?

verses.en: Whether therefore ye eat, or drink, or whatsoever ye do, do all to the glory of God.
verses.fr: Soit donc que vous mangiez, soit que vous buviez, soit que vous fassiez quelque autre chose, faites tout pour la gloire de Dieu.
verses.am: እንግዲህ የምትበሉ ወይም የምትጠጡ ብትሆኑ ወይም ማናቸውን ነገር ብታደርጉ ሁሉን ለእግዚአብሔር ክብር አድርጉት።

verses.en: Give none offence, neither to the Jews, nor to the Gentiles, nor to the church of God:
verses.fr: Ne soyez en scandale ni aux Grecs, ni aux Juifs, ni à l''Eglise de Dieu,

verses.en: Even as I please all men in all things, not seeking mine own profit, but the profit of many, that they may be saved.
verses.fr: de la même manière que moi aussi je m''efforce en toutes choses de complaire à tous, cherchant, non mon avantage, mais celui du plus grand nombre, afin qu''ils soient sauvés.
verses.am: እኔ ደግሞ ብዙዎቹ ይድኑ ዘንድ ለጥቅማቸው እንጂ የራሴን ጥቅም ሳልፈልግ በሁሉ ነገር ሰውን ሁሉ ደስ እንደማሰኝ፥ ለአይሁድም ለግሪክም ሰዎች ለእግዚአብሔር ቤተ ክርስቲያንም ማሰናከያ አትሁኑ።

verses.en: Be ye followers of me, even as I also am of Christ.
verses.fr: Soyez mes imitateurs, comme je le suis moi-même de Christ.
verses.am: እኔ ክርስቶስን እንደምመስል እኔን ምሰሉ።

verses.en: Now I praise you, brethren, that ye remember me in all things, and keep the ordinances, as I delivered them to you.
verses.fr: Je vous loue de ce que vous vous souvenez de moi à tous égards, et de ce que vous retenez mes instructions telles que je vous les ai données.
verses.am: ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ በሁሉ ስለምታስቡኝና አሳልፌ እንደ ሰጠኋችሁ ወግን ፈጽማችሁ ስለ ያዛችሁ አመሰግናችኋለሁ።

verses.en: But I would have you know, that the head of every man is Christ; and the head of the woman is the man; and the head of Christ is God.
verses.fr: Je veux cependant que vous sachiez que Christ est le chef de tout homme, que l''homme est le chef de la femme, et que Dieu est le chef de Christ.
verses.am: ነገር ግን የወንድ ሁሉ ራስ ክርስቶስ፥ የሴትም ራስ ወንድ፥ የክርስቶስም ራስ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆነ ልታውቁ እወዳለሁ።

verses.en: Every man praying or prophesying, having his head covered, dishonoureth his head.
verses.fr: Tout homme qui prie ou qui prophétise, la tête couverte, déshonore son chef.
verses.am: ራሱን ተከናንቦ የሚጸልይ ወይም ትንቢት የሚናገር ወንድ ሁሉ ራሱን ያዋርዳል።

verses.en: But every woman that prayeth or prophesieth with her head uncovered dishonoureth her head: for that is even all one as if she were shaven.
verses.fr: Toute femme, au contraire, qui prie ou qui prophétise, la tête non voilée, déshonore son chef: c''est comme si elle était rasée.
verses.am: ራስዋን ሳትሸፍን ግን የምትጸልይ ወይም ትንቢት የምትናገር ሴት ሁሉ ራስዋን ታዋርዳለች፤ እንደ ተላጨች ያህል አንድ ነውና።

verses.en: For if the woman be not covered, let her also be shorn: but if it be a shame for a woman to be shorn or shaven, let her be covered.
verses.fr: Car si une femme n''est pas voilée, qu''elle se coupe aussi les cheveux. Or, s''il est honteux pour une femme d''avoir les cheveux coupés ou d''être rasée, qu''elle se voile.
verses.am: ሴትም ራስዋን ባትሸፍን ጠጉርዋን ደግሞ ትቆረጥ፤ ለሴት ግን ጠጉርዋን መቆረጥ ወይም መላጨት የሚያሳፍር ከሆነ ራስዋን ትሸፍን።

verses.en: For a man indeed ought not to cover his head, forasmuch as he is the image and glory of God: but the woman is the glory of the man.
verses.fr: L''homme ne doit pas se couvrir la tête, puisqu''il est l''image et la gloire de Dieu, tandis que la femme est la gloire de l''homme.
verses.am: ወንድ የእግዚአብሔር ምሳሌና ክብር ስለ ሆነ ራሱን መከናነብ አይገባውም፤ ሴት ግን የወንድ ክብር ናት።

verses.en: For the man is not of the woman: but the woman of the man.
verses.fr: En effet, l''homme n''a pas été tiré de la femme, mais la femme a été tirée de l''homme;
verses.am: ሴት ከወንድ ናት እንጂ ወንድ ከሴት አይደለምና።

verses.en: Neither was the man created for the woman; but the woman for the man.
verses.fr: et l''homme n''a pas été créé à cause de la femme, mais la femme a été créée à cause de l''homme.
verses.am: ሴት ስለ ወንድ ተፈጠረች እንጂ ወንድ ስለ ሴት አልተፈጠረምና።

verses.en: For this cause ought the woman to have power on her head because of the angels.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi la femme, à cause des anges, doit avoir sur la tête une marque de l''autorité dont elle dépend.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ሴት ከመላእክት የተነሣ በራስዋ ሥልጣን ሊኖራት ይገባል።

verses.en: Nevertheless neither is the man without the woman, neither the woman without the man, in the Lord.
verses.fr: Toutefois, dans le Seigneur, la femme n''est point sans l''homme, ni l''homme sans la femme.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በጌታ ዘንድ ሴት ያለ ወንድ ወንድም ያለ ሴት አይሆንም።

verses.en: For as the woman is of the man, even so is the man also by the woman; but all things of God.
verses.fr: Car, de même que la femme a été tirée de l''homme, de même l''homme existe par la femme, et tout vient de Dieu.
verses.am: ሴት ከወንድ እንደ ሆነች እንዲሁ ወንድ ደግሞ በሴት ነውና፤ ሁሉም ከእግዚአብሔር ነው።

verses.en: Judge in yourselves: is it comely that a woman pray unto God uncovered?
verses.fr: Jugez-en vous-mêmes: est-il convenable qu''une femme prie Dieu sans être voilée?
verses.am: በእናንተ በራሳችሁ መካከል ፍረዱ፤ ሴት ራስዋን ሳትሸፍን ወደ እግዚአብሔር ልትጸልይ ይገባታልን?

verses.en: Doth not even nature itself teach you, that, if a man have long hair, it is a shame unto him?
verses.fr: La nature elle-même ne vous enseigne-t-elle pas que c''est une honte pour l''homme de porter de longs cheveux,
verses.am: ዳሩ ግን ማንም ሊከራከር ቢፈቅድ፥ እኛ ወይም የእግዚአብሔር አብያተ ክርስቲያናት እንዲህ ያለ ልማድ የለንም።

verses.en: But if a woman have long hair, it is a glory to her: for her hair is given her for a covering.
verses.fr: mais que c''est une gloire pour la femme d''en porter, parce que la chevelure lui a été donnée comme voile?
verses.am: ዳሩ ግን ማንም ሊከራከር ቢፈቅድ፥ እኛ ወይም የእግዚአብሔር አብያተ ክርስቲያናት እንዲህ ያለ ልማድ የለንም።

verses.en: But if any man seem to be contentious, we have no such custom, neither the churches of God.
verses.fr: Si quelqu''un se plaît à contester, nous n''avons pas cette habitude, non plus que les Eglises de Dieu.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በምትሰበሰቡበት ጊዜ ለሚከፋ እንጂ ለሚሻል ስላልሆነ ይህን ትእዛዝ ስሰጥ የማመሰግናችሁ አይደለም።

verses.en: Now in this that I declare unto you I praise you not, that ye come together not for the better, but for the worse.
verses.fr: En donnant cet avertissement, ce que je ne loue point, c''est que vous vous assemblez, non pour devenir meilleurs, mais pour devenir pires.
verses.am: በመጀመሪያ ወደ ማኅበር ስትሰበሰቡ በመካከላችሁ መለያየት እንዳለ እሰማለሁና፥ በአንድ በኩልም አምናለሁ።

verses.en: For first of all, when ye come together in the church, I hear that there be divisions among you; and I partly believe it.
verses.fr: Et d''abord, j''apprends que, lorsque vous vous réunissez en assemblée, il y a parmi vous des divisions, -et je le crois en partie,
verses.am: በእናንተ ዘንድ የተፈተኑት እንዲገለጡ በመካከላችሁ ወገኖች ደግሞ ሊሆኑ ግድ ነውና።

verses.en: For there must be also heresies among you, that they which are approved may be made manifest among you.
verses.fr: car il faut qu''il y ait aussi des sectes parmi vous, afin que ceux qui sont approuvés soient reconnus comme tels au milieu de vous. -
verses.am: እንግዲህ አብራችሁ ስትሰበሰቡ የምትበሉት የጌታ እራት አይደለም፤

verses.en: When ye come together therefore into one place, this is not to eat the Lord's supper.
verses.fr: Lors donc que vous vous réunissez, ce n''est pas pour manger le repas du Seigneur;
verses.am: በመብላት ጊዜ እያንዳንዱ የራሱን እራት ይበላልና፥ አንዱም ይራባል አንዱ ግን ይሰክራል።

verses.en: For in eating every one taketh before other his own supper: and one is hungry, and another is drunken.
verses.fr: car, quand on se met à table, chacun commence par prendre son propre repas, et l''un a faim, tandis que l''autre est ivre.
verses.am: የምትበሉባቸውና የምትጠጡባቸው ቤቶች የላችሁምን? ወይስ የእግዚአብሔርን ማኅበር ትንቃላችሁን አንዳችም የሌላቸውን ታሳፍራላችሁን? ምን ልበላችሁ? በዚህ ነገር ላመስግናችሁን? አላመሰግናችሁም።

verses.en: What? have ye not houses to eat and to drink in? or despise ye the church of God, and shame them that have not? what shall I say to you? shall I praise you in this? I praise you not.
verses.fr: N''avez-vous pas des maisons pour y manger et boire? Ou méprisez-vous l''Eglise de Dieu, et faites-vous honte à ceux qui n''ont rien? Que vous dirai-je? Vous louerai-je? En cela je ne vous loue point.
verses.am: ለእናንተ ደግሞ አሳልፌ የሰጠሁትን እኔ ከጌታ ተቀብያለሁና፤

verses.en: For I have received of the Lord that which also I delivered unto you, that the Lord Jesus the same night in which he was betrayed took bread:
verses.fr: Car j''ai reçu du Seigneur ce que je vous ai enseigné; c''est que le Seigneur Jésus, dans la nuit où il fut livré, prit du pain,
verses.am: ጌታ ኢየሱስ አልፎ በተሰጠበት በዚያች ሌሊት እንጀራን አንሥቶ አመሰገነ፥ ቆርሶም። እንካችሁ ብሉ፤ ይህ ስለ እናንተ የሚሆን ሥጋዬ ነው፤ ይህን ለመታሰቢያዬ አድርጉት አለ።

verses.en: And when he had given thanks, he brake it, and said, Take, eat: this is my body, which is broken for you: this do in remembrance of me.
verses.fr: et, après avoir rendu grâces, le rompit, et dit: Ceci est mon corps, qui est rompu pour vous; faites ceci en mémoire de moi.
verses.am: እንደዚሁም ከእራት በኋላ ጽዋውን ደግሞ አንሥቶ። ይህ ጽዋ በደሜ የሚሆን አዲስ ኪዳን ነው፤ በጠጣችሁት ጊዜ ሁሉ ይህን ለመታሰቢያዬ አድርጉት አለ።

verses.en: After the same manner also he took the cup, when he had supped, saying, this cup is the new testament in my blood: this do ye, as oft as ye drink it, in remembrance of me.
verses.fr: De même, après avoir soupé, il prit la coupe, et dit: Cette coupe est la nouvelle alliance en mon sang; faites ceci en mémoire de moi toutes les fois que vous en boirez.
verses.am: ይህን እንጀራ በበላችሁ ጊዜ ሁሉ፥ ይህንም ጽዋ በጠጣችሁ ጊዜ ሁሉ ጌታ እስኪመጣ ድረስ ሞቱን ትናገራላችሁና።

verses.en: For as often as ye eat this bread, and drink this cup, ye do shew the Lord's death till he come.
verses.fr: Car toutes les fois que vous mangez ce pain et que vous buvez cette coupe, vous annoncez la mort du Seigneur, jusqu''à ce qu''il vienne.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ሳይገባው ይህን እንጀራ የበላ ወይም የጌታን ጽዋ የጠጣ ሁሉ የጌታ ሥጋና ደም ዕዳ አለበት።

verses.en: Wherefore whosoever shall eat this bread, and drink this cup of the Lord, unworthily, shall be guilty of the body and blood of the Lord.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi celui qui mangera le pain ou boira la coupe du Seigneur indignement, sera coupable envers le corps et le sang du Seigneur.
verses.am: ሰው ግን ራሱን ይፈትን፥ እንዲሁም ከእንጀራው ይብላ ከጽዋውም ይጠጣ፤

verses.en: But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of that bread, and drink of that cup.
verses.fr: Que chacun donc s''éprouve soi-même, et qu''ainsi il mange du pain et boive de la coupe;
verses.am: ሳይገባው የሚበላና የሚጠጣ የጌታን ሥጋ ስለማይለይ ለራሱ ፍርድ ይበላልና፥ ይጠጣልምና።

verses.en: For he that eateth and drinketh unworthily, eateth and drinketh damnation to himself, not discerning the Lord's body.
verses.fr: car celui qui mange et boit sans discerner le corps du Seigneur, mange et boit un jugement contre lui-même.
verses.am: ስለዚህ በእናንተ ዘንድ የደከሙና የታመሙ ብዙዎች አሉ አያሌዎችም አንቀላፍተዋል።

verses.en: For this cause many are weak and sickly among you, and many sleep.
verses.fr: C''est pour cela qu''il y a parmi vous beaucoup d''infirmes et de malades, et qu''un grand nombre sont morts.
verses.am: ራሳችንን ብንመረምር ግን ባልተፈረደብንም ነበር፤

verses.en: For if we would judge ourselves, we should not be judged.
verses.fr: Si nous nous jugions nous-mêmes, nous ne serions pas jugés.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በተፈረደብን ጊዜ ከዓለም ጋር እንዳንኮነን በጌታ እንገሠጻለን።

verses.en: But when we are judged, we are chastened of the Lord, that we should not be condemned with the world.
verses.fr: Mais quand nous sommes jugés, nous sommes châtiés par le Seigneur, afin que nous ne soyons pas condamnés avec le monde.
verses.am: ስለዚህ፥ ወንድሞቼ ሆይ፥ ለመብላት በተሰበሰባችሁ ጊዜ እርስ በርሳችሁ ተጠባበቁ።

verses.en: Wherefore, my brethren, when ye come together to eat, tarry one for another.
verses.fr: Ainsi, mes frères, lorsque vous vous réunissez pour le repas, attendez-vous les uns les autres.
verses.am: ማንም የራበው ቢኖር ለፍርድ እንዳትሰበሰቡ በቤቱ ይብላ። የቀረውንም ነገር በመጣሁ ጊዜ እደነግጋለሁ።

verses.en: And if any man hunger, let him eat at home; that ye come not together unto condemnation. And the rest will I set in order when I come.
verses.fr: Si quelqu''un a faim, qu''il mange chez lui, afin que vous ne vous réunissiez pas pour attirer un jugement sur vous. Je réglerai les autres choses quand je serai arrivé.
verses.am: ማንም የራበው ቢኖር ለፍርድ እንዳትሰበሰቡ በቤቱ ይብላ። የቀረውንም ነገር በመጣሁ ጊዜ እደነግጋለሁ።

verses.en: Now concerning spiritual gifts, brethren, I would not have you ignorant.
verses.fr: Pour ce qui concerne les dons spirituels, je ne veux pas, frères, que vous soyez dans l''ignorance.
verses.am: ስለ መንፈሳዊ ነገርም፥ ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ ታውቁ ዘንድ እወዳለሁ።

verses.en: Ye know that ye were Gentiles, carried away unto these dumb idols, even as ye were led.
verses.fr: Vous savez que, lorsque vous étiez païens, vous vous laissiez entraîner vers les idoles muettes, selon que vous étiez conduits.
verses.am: አሕዛብ ሳላችሁ በማናቸውም ጊዜ እንደምትመሩ ድምፅ ወደሌላቸው ወደ ጣዖታት እንደ ተወሰዳችሁ ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.en: Wherefore I give you to understand, that no man speaking by the Spirit of God calleth Jesus accursed: and that no man can say that Jesus is the Lord, but by the Holy Ghost.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi je vous déclare que nul, s''il parle par l''Esprit de Dieu, ne dit: Jésus est anathème! et que nul ne peut dire: Jésus est le Seigneur! si ce n''est par le Saint-Esprit.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ማንም በእግዚአብሔር መንፈስ ሲናገር። ኢየሱስ የተረገመ ነው የሚል እንደሌለ፥ በመንፈስ ቅዱስም ካልሆነ በቀር። ኢየሱስ ጌታ ነው ሊል አንድ እንኳ እንዳይችል አስታውቃችኋለሁ።

verses.en: Now there are diversities of gifts, but the same Spirit.
verses.fr: Il y a diversité de dons, mais le même Esprit;
verses.am: የጸጋም ስጦታ ልዩ ልዩ ነው መንፈስ ግን አንድ ነው፤

verses.en: And there are differences of administrations, but the same Lord.
verses.fr: diversité de ministères, mais le même Seigneur;
verses.am: አገልግሎትም ልዩ ልዩ ነው ጌታም አንድ ነው፤

verses.en: And there are diversities of operations, but it is the same God which worketh all in all.
verses.fr: diversité d''opérations, mais le même Dieu qui opère tout en tous.
verses.am: አሠራርም ልዩ ልዩ ነው፥ ሁሉን በሁሉ የሚያደርግ እግዚአብሔር ግን አንድ ነው።

verses.en: But the manifestation of the Spirit is given to every man to profit withal.
verses.fr: Or, à chacun la manifestation de l''Esprit est donnée pour l''utilité commune.
verses.am: ነገር ግን መንፈስ ቅዱስን መግለጥ ለእያንዳንዱ ለጥቅም ይሰጠዋል።

verses.en: For to one is given by the Spirit the word of wisdom; to another the word of knowledge by the same Spirit;
verses.fr: En effet, à l''un est donnée par l''Esprit une parole de sagesse; à un autre, une parole de connaissance, selon le même Esprit;
verses.am: ለአንዱ ጥበብን መናገር በመንፈስ ይሰጠዋልና፥ ለአንዱም በዚያው መንፈስ እውቀትን መናገር ይሰጠዋል፥

verses.en: To another faith by the same Spirit; to another the gifts of healing by the same Spirit;
verses.fr: à un autre, la foi, par le même Esprit; à un autre, le don des guérisons, par le même Esprit;
verses.am: ለአንዱም በዚያው መንፈስ እምነት፥ ለአንዱም በአንዱ መንፈስ የመፈወስ ስጦታ፥ ለአንዱም ተአምራትን ማድረግ፥

verses.en: To another the working of miracles; to another prophecy; to another discerning of spirits; to another divers kinds of tongues; to another the interpretation of tongues:
verses.fr: à un autre, le don d''opérer des miracles; à un autre, la prophétie; à un autre, le discernement des esprits; à un autre, la diversité des langues; à un autre, l''interprétation des langues.
verses.am: ለአንዱም ትንቢትን መናገር፥ ለአንዱም መናፍስትን መለየት፥ ለአንዱም በልዩ ዓይነት ልሳን መናገር፥ ለአንዱም በልሳኖች የተነገረውን መተርጎም ይሰጠዋል፤

verses.en: But all these worketh that one and the selfsame Spirit, dividing to every man severally as he will.
verses.fr: Un seul et même Esprit opère toutes ces choses, les distribuant à chacun en particulier comme il veut.
verses.am: ይህን ሁሉ ግን ያ አንዱ መንፈስ እንደሚፈቅድ ለእያንዳንዱ ለብቻው እያካፈለ ያደርጋል።

verses.en: For as the body is one, and hath many members, and all the members of that one body, being many, are one body: so also is Christ.
verses.fr: Car, comme le corps est un et a plusieurs membres, et comme tous les membres du corps, malgré leur nombre, ne forment qu''un seul corps, ainsi en est-il de Christ.
verses.am: አካልም አንድ እንደ ሆነ ብዙም ብልቶች እንዳሉበት ነገር ግን የአካል ብልቶች ሁሉ ብዙዎች ሳሉ አንድ አካል እንደ ሆኑ፥ ክርስቶስ ደግሞ እንዲሁ ነው፤

verses.en: For by one Spirit are we all baptized into one body, whether we be Jews or Gentiles, whether we be bond or free; and have been all made to drink into one Spirit.
verses.fr: Nous avons tous, en effet, été baptisés dans un seul Esprit, pour former un seul corps, soit Juifs, soit Grecs, soit esclaves, soit libres, et nous avons tous été abreuvés d''un seul Esprit.
verses.am: አይሁድ ብንሆን የግሪክ ሰዎችም ብንሆን ባሪያዎችም ብንሆን ጨዋዎችም ብንሆን እኛ ሁላችን በአንድ መንፈስ አንድ አካል እንድንሆን ተጠምቀናልና። ሁላችንም አንዱን መንፈስ ጠጥተናል።

verses.en: For the body is not one member, but many.
verses.fr: Ainsi le corps n''est pas un seul membre, mais il est formé de plusieurs membres.
verses.am: አካል ብዙ ብልቶች እንጂ አንድ ብልት አይደለምና።

verses.en: If the foot shall say, Because I am not the hand, I am not of the body; is it therefore not of the body?
verses.fr: Si le pied disait: Parce que je ne suis pas une main, je ne suis pas du corps,  ne serait-il pas du corps pour cela?
verses.am: እግር። እኔ እጅ አይደለሁምና የአካል ክፍል አይደለሁም ብትል፥ ይህን በማለትዋ የአካል ክፍል መሆንዋ ይቀራልን?

verses.en: And if the ear shall say, Because I am not the eye, I am not of the body; is it therefore not of the body?
verses.fr: Et si l''oreille disait: Parce que je ne suis pas un oeil, je ne suis pas du corps,  ne serait-elle pas du corps pour cela?
verses.am: ጆሮም። እኔ ዓይን አይደለሁምና የአካል ክፍል አይደለሁም ቢል፥ ይህን በማለቱ የአካል ክፍል መሆኑ ይቀራልን?

verses.en: If the whole body were an eye, where were the hearing? If the whole were hearing, where were the smelling?
verses.fr: Si tout le corps était oeil, où serait l''ouïe? S''il était tout ouïe, où serait l''odorat?
verses.am: አካል ሁሉ ዓይን ቢሆን መስማት ወዴት በተገኘ? ሁሉም መስማት ቢሆን ማሽተት ወዴት በተገኘ?

verses.en: But now hath God set the members every one of them in the body, as it hath pleased him.
verses.fr: Maintenant Dieu a placé chacun des membres dans le corps comme il a voulu.
verses.am: አሁን ግን እግዚአብሔር እንደ ወደደ ብልቶችን እያንዳንዳቸው በአካል አድርጎአል።

verses.en: And if they were all one member, where were the body?
verses.fr: Si tous étaient un seul membre, où serait le corps?
verses.am: ሁሉም አንድ ብልት ቢሆንስ አካል ወዴት በሆነ?

verses.en: But now are they many members, yet but one body.
verses.fr: Maintenant donc il y a plusieurs membres, et un seul corps.
verses.am: ዳሩ ግን አሁን ብልቶች ብዙዎች ናቸው አካል ግን አንድ ነው።

verses.en: And the eye cannot say unto the hand, I have no need of thee: nor again the head to the feet, I have no need of you.
verses.fr: L''oeil ne peut pas dire à la main: Je n''ai pas besoin de toi; ni la tête dire aux pieds: Je n''ai pas besoin de vous.
verses.am: ዓይን እጅን። አታስፈልገኝም ልትለው አትችልም፥ ወይም ራስ ደግሞ እግሮችን። አታስፈልጉኝም ሊላቸው አይችልም።

verses.en: Nay, much more those members of the body, which seem to be more feeble, are necessary:
verses.fr: Mais bien plutôt, les membres du corps qui paraissent être les plus faibles sont nécessaires;
verses.am: ነገር ግን ደካሞች የሚመስሉ የአካል ብልቶች ይልቁን የሚያስፈልጉ ናቸው፤

verses.en: And those members of the body, which we think to be less honourable, upon these we bestow more abundant honour; and our uncomely parts have more abundant comeliness.
verses.fr: et ceux que nous estimons être les moins honorables du corps, nous les entourons d''un plus grand honneur. Ainsi nos membres les moins honnêtes reçoivent le plus d''honneur,
verses.am: ከአካልም ብልቶች ያልከበሩ ሆነው የሚመስሉን በሚበዛ ክብር እናለብሳቸዋለን፥ በምናፍርባቸውም ብልቶቻችን ክብር ይጨመርላቸዋል፤

verses.en: For our comely parts have no need: but God hath tempered the body together, having given more abundant honour to that part which lacked.
verses.fr: tandis que ceux qui sont honnêtes n''en ont pas besoin. Dieu a disposé le corps de manière à donner plus d''honneur à ce qui en manquait,
verses.am: አንድም ብልት ቢሣቀይ ብልቶች ሁሉ ከእርሱ ጋር ይሣቀያሉ፤ አንድ ብልትም ቢከበር ብልቶች ሁሉ ከእርሱ ጋር ደስ ይላቸዋል።

verses.en: That there should be no schism in the body; but that the members should have the same care one for another.
verses.fr: afin qu''il n''y ait pas de division dans le corps, mais que les membres aient également soin les uns des autres.
verses.am: አንድም ብልት ቢሣቀይ ብልቶች ሁሉ ከእርሱ ጋር ይሣቀያሉ፤ አንድ ብልትም ቢከበር ብልቶች ሁሉ ከእርሱ ጋር ደስ ይላቸዋል።

verses.en: And whether one member suffer, all the members suffer with it; or one member be honoured, all the members rejoice with it.
verses.fr: Et si un membre souffre, tous les membres souffrent avec lui; si un membre est honoré, tous les membres se réjouissent avec lui.
verses.am: እናንተም የክርስቶስ አካል ናችሁ እያንዳንዳችሁም ብልቶች ናችሁ።

verses.en: Now ye are the body of Christ, and members in particular.
verses.fr: Vous êtes le corps de Christ, et vous êtes ses membres, chacun pour sa part.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በቤተ ክርስቲያን አንዳንዶቹን አስቀድሞ ሐዋርያትን፥ ሁለተኛም ነቢያትን፥ ሦስተኛም አስተማሪዎችን፥ ቀጥሎም ተአምራት ማድረግን፥ ቀጥሎም የመፈወስን ስጦታ፥ እርዳታንም፥ አገዛዝንም፥ የልዩ ልዩ ዓይነት ልሳኖችንም አድርጎአል።

verses.en: And God hath set some in the church, first apostles, secondarily prophets, thirdly teachers, after that miracles, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, diversities of tongues.
verses.fr: Et Dieu a établi dans l''Eglise premièrement des apôtres, secondement des prophètes, troisièmement des docteurs, ensuite ceux qui ont le don des miracles, puis ceux qui ont les dons de guérir, de secourir, de gouverner, de parler diverses langues.
verses.am: ሁሉ ሐዋርያት ናቸውን? ሁሉስ ነቢያት ናቸውን? ሁሉስ አስተማሪዎች ናቸውን? ሁሉስ ተአምራትን ይሠራሉን?

verses.en: Are all apostles? are all prophets? are all teachers? are all workers of miracles?
verses.fr: Tous sont-ils apôtres? Tous sont-ils prophètes? Tous sont-ils docteurs? Tous ont-ils le don des miracles?
verses.am: ሁሉስ የመፈወስ ስጦታ አላቸውን? ሁሉስ በልሳኖች ይናገራሉን? ሁሉስ ይተረጉማሉን?

verses.en: Have all the gifts of healing? do all speak with tongues? do all interpret?
verses.fr: Tous ont-ils le don des guérisons? Tous parlent-ils en langues? Tous interprètent-ils?
verses.am: ነገር ግን የሚበልጠውን የጸጋ ስጦታ በብርቱ ፈልጉ። ደግሞም ከሁሉ የሚበልጥ መንገድ አሳያችኋለሁ።

verses.en: But covet earnestly the best gifts: and yet shew I unto you a more excellent way.
verses.fr: Aspirez aux dons les meilleurs. Et je vais encore vous montrer une voie par excellence.
verses.am: ነገር ግን የሚበልጠውን የጸጋ ስጦታ በብርቱ ፈልጉ። ደግሞም ከሁሉ የሚበልጥ መንገድ አሳያችኋለሁ።

verses.en: Though I speak with the tongues of men and of angels, and have not charity, I am become as sounding brass, or a tinkling cymbal.
verses.fr: Quand je parlerais les langues des hommes et des anges, si je n''ai pas la charité, je suis un airain qui résonne, ou une cymbale qui retentit.
verses.am: በሰዎችና በመላእክት ልሳን ብናገር ፍቅር ግን ከሌለኝ እንደሚጮኽ ናስ ወይም እንደሚንሽዋሽዋ ጸናጽል ሆኜአለሁ።

verses.en: And though I have the gift of prophecy, and understand all mysteries, and all knowledge; and though I have all faith, so that I could remove mountains, and have not charity, I am nothing.
verses.fr: Et quand j''aurais le don de prophétie, la science de tous les mystères et toute la connaissance, quand j''aurais même toute la foi jusqu''à transporter des montagnes, si je n''ai pas la charité, je ne suis rien.
verses.am: ትንቢትም ቢኖረኝ ምሥጢርንም ሁሉና እውቀትን ሁሉ ባውቅ፥ ተራሮችንም እስካፈልስ ድረስ እምነት ሁሉ ቢኖረኝ ፍቅር ግን ከሌለኝ ከንቱ ነኝ።

verses.en: And though I bestow all my goods to feed the poor, and though I give my body to be burned, and have not charity, it profiteth me nothing.
verses.fr: Et quand je distribuerais tous mes biens pour la nourriture des pauvres, quand je livrerais même mon corps pour être brûlé, si je n''ai pas la charité, cela ne me sert de rien.
verses.am: ድሆችንም ልመግብ ያለኝን ሁሉ ባካፍል፥ ሥጋዬንም ለእሳት መቃጠል አሳልፌ ብሰጥ ፍቅር ግን ከሌለኝ ምንም አይጠቅመኝም።

verses.en: Charity suffereth long, and is kind; charity envieth not; charity vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up,
verses.fr: La charité est patiente, elle est pleine de bonté; la charité n''est point envieuse; la charité ne se vante point, elle ne s''enfle point d''orgueil,
verses.am: ፍቅር ይታገሣል፥ ቸርነትንም ያደርጋል፤ ፍቅር አይቀናም፤ ፍቅር አይመካም፥ አይታበይም፤

verses.en: Doth not behave itself unseemly, seeketh not her own, is not easily provoked, thinketh no evil;
verses.fr: elle ne fait rien de malhonnête, elle ne cherche point son intérêt, elle ne s''irrite point, elle ne soupçonne point le mal,
verses.am: የማይገባውን አያደርግም፥ የራሱንም አይፈልግም፥ አይበሳጭም፥ በደልን አይቆጥርም፤

verses.en: Rejoiceth not in iniquity, but rejoiceth in the truth;
verses.fr: elle ne se réjouit point de l''injustice, mais elle se réjouit de la vérité;
verses.am: ከእውነት ጋር ደስ ይለዋል እንጂ ስለ ዓመፃ ደስ አይለውም፤

verses.en: Beareth all things, believeth all things, hopeth all things, endureth all things.
verses.fr: elle excuse tout, elle croit tout, elle espère tout, elle supporte tout.
verses.am: ሁሉን ይታገሣል፥ ሁሉን ያምናል፥ ሁሉን ተስፋ ያደርጋል፥ በሁሉ ይጸናል።

verses.en: Charity never faileth: but whether there be prophecies, they shall fail; whether there be tongues, they shall cease; whether there be knowledge, it shall vanish away.
verses.fr: La charité ne périt jamais. Les prophéties prendront fin, les langues cesseront, la connaissance disparaîtra.
verses.am: ፍቅር ለዘወትር አይወድቅም፤ ትንቢት ቢሆን ግን ይሻራል፤ ልሳኖች ቢሆኑ ይቀራሉ፤ እውቀትም ቢሆን ይሻራል።

verses.en: For we know in part, and we prophesy in part.
verses.fr: Car nous connaissons en partie, et nous prophétisons en partie,
verses.am: ከእውቀት ከፍለን እናውቃለንና፥ ከትንቢትም ከፍለን እንናገራለንና፤

verses.en: But when that which is perfect is come, then that which is in part shall be done away.
verses.fr: mais quand ce qui est parfait sera venu, ce qui est partiel disparaîtra.
verses.am: ፍጹም የሆነ ሲመጣ ግን ተከፍሎ የነበረው ይሻራል።

verses.en: When I was a child, I spake as a child, I understood as a child, I thought as a child: but when I became a man, I put away childish things.
verses.fr: Lorsque j''étais enfant, je parlais comme un enfant, je pensais comme un enfant, je raisonnais comme un enfant; lorsque je suis devenu homme, j''ai fait disparaître ce qui était de l''enfant.
verses.am: ልጅ ሳለሁ እንደ ልጅ እናገር ነበር፥ እንደ ልጅም አስብ ነበር፥ እንደ ልጅም እቈጥር ነበር፤ ጎልማሳ ሆኜ ግን የልጅነትን ጠባይ ሽሬአለሁ።

verses.en: For now we see through a glass, darkly; but then face to face: now I know in part; but then shall I know even as also I am known.
verses.fr: Aujourd''hui nous voyons au moyen d''un miroir, d''une manière obscure, mais alors nous verrons face à face; aujourd''hui je connais en partie, mais alors je connaîtrai comme j''ai été connu.
verses.am: ዛሬስ በመስተዋት በድንግዝግዝ እንደምናይ ነን በዚያን ጊዜ ግን ፊት ለፊት እናያለን፤ ዛሬስ ከእውቀት ከፍዬ አውቃለሁ በዚያን ጊዜ ግን እኔ ደግሞ እንደ ታወቅሁ አውቃለሁ።

verses.en: And now abideth faith, hope, charity, these three; but the greatest of these is charity.
verses.fr: Maintenant donc ces trois choses demeurent: la foi, l''espérance, la charité; mais la plus grande de ces choses, c''est la charité.
verses.am: እንዲህም ከሆነ፥ እምነት ተስፋ ፍቅር እነዚህ ሦስቱ ጸንተው ይኖራሉ፤ ከእነዚህም የሚበልጠው ፍቅር ነው።

verses.en: Follow after charity, and desire spiritual gifts, but rather that ye may prophesy.
verses.fr: Recherchez la charité. Aspirez aussi aux dons spirituels, mais surtout à celui de prophétie.
verses.am: ፍቅርን ተከታተሉ፥ መንፈሳዊ ስጦታንም ይልቁንም ትንቢት መናገርን በብርቱ ፈልጉ።

verses.en: For he that speaketh in an unknown tongue speaketh not unto men, but unto God: for no man understandeth him; howbeit in the spirit he speaketh mysteries.
verses.fr: En effet, celui qui parle en langue ne parle pas aux hommes, mais à Dieu, car personne ne le comprend, et c''est en esprit qu''il dit des mystères.
verses.am: በልሳን የሚናገርስ ለእግዚአብሔር እንጂ ለሰው አይናገርም፤ የሚያስተውለው የለምና፥ በመንፈስ ግን ምሥጢርን ይናገራል፤

verses.en: But he that prophesieth speaketh unto men to edification, and exhortation, and comfort.
verses.fr: Celui qui prophétise, au contraire, parle aux hommes, les édifie, les exhorte, les console.
verses.am: ትንቢትን የሚናገር ግን ለማነጽና ለመምከር ለማጽናናትም ለሰው ይናገራል።

verses.en: He that speaketh in an unknown tongue edifieth himself; but he that prophesieth edifieth the church.
verses.fr: Celui qui parle en langue s''édifie lui-même; celui qui prophétise édifie l''Eglise.
verses.am: በልሳን የሚናገር ራሱን ያንጻል፤ ትንቢትን የሚናገር ግን ማኅበሩን ያንጻል።

verses.en: I would that ye all spake with tongues but rather that ye prophesied: for greater is he that prophesieth than he that speaketh with tongues, except he interpret, that the church may receive edifying.
verses.fr: Je désire que vous parliez tous en langues, mais encore plus que vous prophétisiez. Celui qui prophétise est plus grand que celui qui parle en langues, à moins que ce dernier n''interprète, pour que l''Eglise en reçoive de l''édification.
verses.am: ሁላችሁ በልሳኖች ልትናገሩ እወድ ነበር፥ ትንቢትን ልትናገሩ ግን ከዚህ ይልቅ እወዳለሁ፤ ማኅበሩ ይታነጽ ዘንድ ንግግሩን ባይተረጐም በልሳኖች ከሚናገር ትንቢትን የሚናገር ይበልጣል።

verses.en: Now, brethren, if I come unto you speaking with tongues, what shall I profit you, except I shall speak to you either by revelation, or by knowledge, or by prophesying, or by doctrine?
verses.fr: Et maintenant, frères, de quelle utilité vous serais-je, si je venais à vous parlant en langues, et si je ne vous parlais pas par révélation, ou par connaissance, ou par prophétie, ou par doctrine?
verses.am: አሁን ግን፥ ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ ወደ እናንተ መጥቼ በልሳኖች ብናገር፥ በመግለጥ ወይም በእውቀት ወይም በትንቢት ወይም በትምህርት ካልነገርኋችሁ ምን እጠቅማችኋለሁ?

verses.en: And even things without life giving sound, whether pipe or harp, except they give a distinction in the sounds, how shall it be known what is piped or harped?
verses.fr: Si les objets inanimés qui rendent un son, comme une flûte ou une harpe, ne rendent pas des sons distincts, comment reconnaîtra-t-on ce qui est joué sur la flûte ou sur la harpe?
verses.am: ነፍስ የሌለበት ነገር እንኳ ዋሽንትም ክራርም ቢሆን ድምፅ ሲሰጥ የድምፁን ልዩነት ባይገልጥ በዋሽንት የሚነፋው ወይስ በክራር የሚመታው መዝሙር እንዴት ይታወቃል?

verses.en: For if the trumpet give an uncertain sound, who shall prepare himself to the battle?
verses.fr: Et si la trompette rend un son confus, qui se préparera au combat?
verses.am: ደግሞም መለከት የማይገለጥን ድምፅ ቢሰጥ ለጦርነት ማን ይዘጋጃል?

verses.en: So likewise ye, except ye utter by the tongue words easy to be understood, how shall it be known what is spoken? for ye shall speak into the air.
verses.fr: De même vous, si par la langue vous ne donnez pas une parole distincte, comment saura-t-on ce que vous dites? Car vous parlerez en l''air.
verses.am: እንዲሁ እናንተ ደግሞ የተገለጠውን ቃል በአንደበት ባትናገሩ ሰዎች የምትናገሩትን እንዴት አድርገው ያስተውሉታል? ለነፋስ የምትናገሩ ትሆናላችሁና።

verses.en: There are, it may be, so many kinds of voices in the world, and none of them is without signification.
verses.fr: Quelque nombreuses que puissent être dans le monde les diverses langues, il n''en est aucune qui ne soit une langue intelligible;
verses.am: በዓለም ምናልባት ቁጥር የሌለው የቋንቋ ዓይነት ይኖራል ቋንቋም የሌለው ሕዝብ የለም፤

verses.en: Therefore if I know not the meaning of the voice, I shall be unto him that speaketh a barbarian, and he that speaketh shall be a barbarian unto me.
verses.fr: si donc je ne connais pas le sens de la langue, je serai un barbare pour celui qui parle, et celui qui parle sera un barbare pour moi.
verses.am: እንግዲህ የቋንቋውን ፍች ባላውቅ ለሚናገረው እንግዳ እሆናለሁ፥ የሚናገረውም ለእኔ እንግዳ ይሆናል።

verses.en: Even so ye, forasmuch as ye are zealous of spiritual gifts, seek that ye may excel to the edifying of the church.
verses.fr: De même vous, puisque vous aspirez aux dons spirituels, que ce soit pour l''édification de l''Eglise que vous cherchiez à en posséder abondamment.
verses.am: እንዲሁ ደግሞ እናንተ መንፈሳዊ ስጦታን በብርቱ የምትፈልጉ ከሆናችሁ ቤተ ክርስቲያንን ለማነጽ እንዲበዛላችሁ ፈልጉ።

verses.en: Wherefore let him that speaketh in an unknown tongue pray that he may interpret.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi, que celui qui parle en langue prie pour avoir le don d''interpréter.
verses.am: ስለዚህ በልሳን የሚናገር እንዲተረጉም ይጸልይ።

verses.en: For if I pray in an unknown tongue, my spirit prayeth, but my understanding is unfruitful.
verses.fr: Car si je prie en langue, mon esprit est en prière, mais mon intelligence demeure stérile.
verses.am: በልሳን ብጸልይ መንፈሴ ይጸልያል አእምሮዬ ግን ያለ ፍሬ ነው።

verses.en: What is it then? I will pray with the spirit, and I will pray with the understanding also: I will sing with the spirit, and I will sing with the understanding also.
verses.fr: Que faire donc? Je prierai par l''esprit, mais je prierai aussi avec l''intelligence; je chanterai par l''esprit, mais je chanterai aussi avec l''intelligence.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ምንድር ነው? በመንፈስ እጸልያለሁ በአእምሮም ደግሞ እጸልያለሁ፤ በመንፈስ እዘምራለሁ በአእምሮም ደግሞ እዘምራለሁ።

verses.en: Else when thou shalt bless with the spirit, how shall he that occupieth the room of the unlearned say Amen at thy giving of thanks, seeing he understandeth not what thou sayest?
verses.fr: Autrement, si tu rends grâces par l''esprit, comment celui qui est dans les rangs de l''homme du peuple répondra-t-il Amen! à ton action de grâces, puisqu''il ne sait pas ce que tu dis?
verses.am: እንዲያማ ካልሆነ፥ አንተ በመንፈስ ብትባርክ ባልተማሩት ስፍራ የተቀመጠው የምትለውን ካላወቀ እንዴት አድርጎ ለምስጋናህ አሜን ይላል?

verses.en: For thou verily givest thanks well, but the other is not edified.
verses.fr: Tu rends, il est vrai, d''excellentes actions de grâces, mais l''autre n''est pas édifié.
verses.am: አንተማ መልካም ታመሰግናለህ፥ ሌላው ግን አይታነጽበትም።

verses.en: I thank my God, I speak with tongues more than ye all:
verses.fr: Je rends grâces à Dieu de ce que je parle en langue plus que vous tous;
verses.am: ከሁላችሁ ይልቅ በልሳኖች እናገራለሁና እግዚአብሔርን አመሰግናለሁ፤

verses.en: Yet in the church I had rather speak five words with my understanding, that by my voice I might teach others also, than ten thousand words in an unknown tongue.
verses.fr: mais, dans l''Eglise, j''aime mieux dire cinq paroles avec mon intelligence, afin d''instruire aussi les autres, que dix mille paroles en langue.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ሌሎችን ደግሞ አስተምር ዘንድ በማኅበር እልፍ ቃላት በልሳን ከመናገር ይልቅ አምስት ቃላት በአእምሮዬ ልናገር እወዳለሁ።

verses.en: Brethren, be not children in understanding: howbeit in malice be ye children, but in understanding be men.
verses.fr: Frères, ne soyez pas des enfants sous le rapport du jugement; mais pour la malice, soyez enfants, et, à l''égard du jugement, soyez des hommes faits.
verses.am: ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ በአእምሮ ሕፃናት አትሁኑ፤ ለክፋት ነገር ሕፃናት ሁኑ እንጂ በአእምሮ የበሰሉ ሁኑ።

verses.en: In the law it is written, With men of other tongues and other lips will I speak unto this people; and yet for all that will they not hear me, saith the Lord.
verses.fr: Il est écrit dans la loi: C''est par des hommes d''une autre langue Et par des lèvres d''étrangers Que je parlerai à ce peuple, Et ils ne m''écouteront pas même ainsi, dit le Seigneur.
verses.am: ሌሎችን ልሳኖች በሚናገሩ ሰዎችና በሌላ አንደበት ለዚህ ሕዝብ እነግራቸዋለሁ፥ እንዲህም ቢሆን አይሰሙኝም ይላል ጌታ ተብሎ በሕግ ተጽፎአል።

verses.en: Wherefore tongues are for a sign, not to them that believe, but to them that believe not: but prophesying serveth not for them that believe not, but for them which believe.
verses.fr: Par conséquent, les langues sont un signe, non pour les croyants, mais pour les non-croyants; la prophétie, au contraire, est un signe, non pour les non-croyants, mais pour les croyants.
verses.am: እንግዲያስ በልሳኖች መናገር ለማያምኑ ምልክት ነው እንጂ ለሚያምኑ አይደለም፥ ትንቢት ግን ለሚያምኑ እንጂ ለማያምኑ አይደለም።

verses.en: If therefore the whole church be come together into one place, and all speak with tongues, and there come in those that are unlearned, or unbelievers, will they not say that ye are mad?
verses.fr: Si donc, dans une assemblée de l''Eglise entière, tous parlent en langues, et qu''il survienne des hommes du peuple ou des non-croyants, ne diront-ils pas que vous êtes fous?
verses.am: እንግዲህ ማኅበር ሁሉ አብረው ቢሰበሰቡ ሁሉም በልሳኖች ቢናገሩና ያልተማሩ ወይም የማያምኑ ሰዎች ቢገቡ። አብደዋል አይሉምን?

verses.en: But if all prophesy, and there come in one that believeth not, or one unlearned, he is convinced of all, he is judged of all:
verses.fr: Mais si tous prophétisent, et qu''il survienne quelque non-croyant ou un homme du peuple, il est convaincu par tous, il est jugé par tous,
verses.am: ሁሉ ትንቢት ቢናገሩ ግን የማያምን ወይም ያልተማረ ሰው ቢገባ በሁሉ ይወቀሳል፥ በሁሉም ይመረመራል፤

verses.en: And thus are the secrets of his heart made manifest; and so falling down on his face he will worship God, and report that God is in you of a truth.
verses.fr: les secrets de son coeur sont dévoilés, de telle sorte que, tombant sur sa face, il adorera Dieu, et publiera que Dieu est réellement au milieu de vous.
verses.am: በልቡም የተሰወረ ይገለጣል እንዲሁም። እግዚአብሔር በእውነት በመካከላቸው ነው ብሎ እየተናገረ በፊቱ ወድቆ ለእግዚአብሔር ይሰግዳል።

verses.en: How is it then, brethren? when ye come together, every one of you hath a psalm, hath a doctrine, hath a tongue, hath a revelation, hath an interpretation. Let all things be done unto edifying.
verses.fr: Que faire donc, frères? Lorsque vous vous assemblez, les uns ou les autres parmi vous ont-ils un cantique, une instruction, une révélation, une langue, une interprétation, que tout se fasse pour l''édification.
verses.am: እንግዲህ፥ ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ ምንድር ነው? በምትሰበሰቡበት ጊዜ ለእያንዳንዱ መዝሙር አለው፥ ትምህርት አለው፥ መግለጥ አለው፥ በልሳን መናገር አለው፥ መተርጐም አለው፤ ሁሉ ለማነጽ ይሁን።

verses.en: If any man speak in an unknown tongue, let it be by two, or at the most by three, and that by course; and let one interpret.
verses.fr: En est-il qui parlent en langue, que deux ou trois au plus parlent, chacun à son tour, et que quelqu''un interprète;
verses.am: በልሳን የሚናገር ቢኖር ሁለት ወይም ቢበዛ ሦስት ሆነው በተራቸው ይናገሩ አንዱም ይተርጉም፤

verses.en: But if there be no interpreter, let him keep silence in the church; and let him speak to himself, and to God.
verses.fr: s''il n''y a point d''interprète, qu''on se taise dans l''Eglise, et qu''on parle à soi-même et à Dieu.
verses.am: የሚተረጉም ባይኖር ግን በማኅበር መካከል ዝም ይበልና ለራሱና ለእግዚአብሔር ይናገር።

verses.en: Let the prophets speak two or three, and let the other judge.
verses.fr: Pour ce qui est des prophètes, que deux ou trois parlent, et que les autres jugent;
verses.am: ነቢያትም ሁለት ወይም ሦስት ሆነው ይናገሩ ሌሎችም ይለዩአቸው፤

verses.en: If any thing be revealed to another that sitteth by, let the first hold his peace.
verses.fr: et si un autre qui est assis a une révélation, que le premier se taise.
verses.am: በዚያ ለሚቀመጥ ለሌላ ግን አንድ ነገር ቢገለጥለት ፊተኛው ዝም ይበል።

verses.en: For ye may all prophesy one by one, that all may learn, and all may be comforted.
verses.fr: Car vous pouvez tous prophétiser successivement, afin que tous soient instruits et que tous soient exhortés.
verses.am: ሁሉም እንዲማሩ ሁሉም እንዲመከሩ ሁላችሁ በእያንዳንዳችሁ ትንቢት ልትናገሩ ትችላላችሁ።

verses.en: And the spirits of the prophets are subject to the prophets.
verses.fr: Les esprits des prophètes sont soumis aux prophètes;
verses.am: የነቢያትም መናፍስት ለነቢያት ይገዛሉ፤

verses.en: For God is not the author of confusion, but of peace, as in all churches of the saints.
verses.fr: car Dieu n''est pas un Dieu de désordre, mais de paix. Comme dans toutes les Eglises des saints,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርስ የሰላም አምላክ ነው እንጂ የሁከት አምላክ አይደለምና፤ በቅዱሳንም አብያተ ክርስቲያናት ሁሉ እንዲህ ነው።

verses.en: Let your women keep silence in the churches: for it is not permitted unto them to speak; but they are commanded to be under obedience as also saith the law.
verses.fr: que les femmes se taisent dans les assemblées, car il ne leur est pas permis d''y parler; mais qu''elles soient soumises, selon que le dit aussi la loi.
verses.am: ሴቶች በማኅበር ዝም ይበሉ፤ ሕግ ደግሞ እንደሚል እንዲገዙ እንጂ እንዲናገሩ አልተፈቀደላቸውምና።

verses.en: And if they will learn any thing, let them ask their husbands at home: for it is a shame for women to speak in the church.
verses.fr: Si elles veulent s''instruire sur quelque chose, qu''elles interrogent leurs maris à la maison; car il est malséant à une femme de parler dans l''Eglise.
verses.am: ለሴት በማኅበር መካከል መናገር ነውር ነውና፥ ምንም ሊማሩ ቢወዱ በቤታቸው ባሎቻቸውን ይጠይቁ።

verses.en: What? came the word of God out from you? or came it unto you only?
verses.fr: Est-ce de chez vous que la parole de Dieu est sortie? ou est-ce à vous seuls qu''elle est parvenue?
verses.am: ምን ነው? የእግዚአብሔር ቃል የወጣ ከእናንተ ነውን? ወይስ ወደ እናንተ ብቻ ደርሶአልን?

verses.en: If any man think himself to be a prophet, or spiritual, let him acknowledge that the things that I write unto you are the commandments of the Lord.
verses.fr: Si quelqu''un croit être prophète ou inspiré, qu''il reconnaisse que ce que je vous écris est un commandement du Seigneur.
verses.am: ማንም ነቢይ ወይም መንፈሳዊ የሆነ ቢመስለው ይህች የጻፍሁላችሁ የጌታ ትእዛዝ እንደ ሆነች ይወቅ፤

verses.en: But if any man be ignorant, let him be ignorant.
verses.fr: Et si quelqu''un l''ignore, qu''il l''ignore.
verses.am: ማንም የማያውቅ ቢኖር ግን አይወቅ።

verses.en: Wherefore, brethren, covet to prophesy, and forbid not to speak with tongues.
verses.fr: Ainsi donc, frères, aspirez au don de prophétie, et n''empêchez pas de parler en langues.
verses.am: ስለዚህ፥ ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ ትንቢት ለመናገር በብርቱ ፈልጉ፥ በልሳኖች ከመናገርም አትከልክሉ፤

verses.en: Let all things be done decently and in order.
verses.fr: Mais que tout se fasse avec bienséance et avec ordre.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ሁሉ በአገባብና በሥርዓት ይሁን።

verses.en: Moreover, brethren, I declare unto you the gospel which I preached unto you, which also ye have received, and wherein ye stand;
verses.fr: Je vous rappelle, frères, l''Evangile que je vous ai annoncé, que vous avez reçu, dans lequel vous avez persévéré,
verses.am: ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ የሰበክሁላችሁን ደግሞም የተቀበላችሁትን በእርሱም ደግሞ የቆማችሁበትን በእርሱም ደግሞ የምትድኑበትን ወንጌል አሳስባችኋለሁ፤

verses.en: By which also ye are saved, if ye keep in memory what I preached unto you, unless ye have believed in vain.
verses.fr: et par lequel vous êtes sauvés, si vous le retenez tel que je vous l''ai annoncé; autrement, vous auriez cru en vain.
verses.am: በከንቱ ካላመናችሁ በቀር፥ ብታስቡት፥ በምን ቃል እንደ ሰበክሁላችሁ አሳስባችኋለሁ።

verses.en: For I delivered unto you first of all that which I also received, how that Christ died for our sins according to the scriptures;
verses.fr: Je vous ai enseigné avant tout, comme je l''avais aussi reçu, que Christ est mort pour nos péchés, selon les Ecritures;
verses.am: እኔ ደግሞ የተቀበልሁትን ከሁሉ በፊት አሳልፌ ሰጠኋችሁ እንዲህ ብዬ። መጽሐፍ እንደሚል ክርስቶስ ስለ ኃጢአታችን ሞተ፥ ተቀበረም፥

verses.en: And that he was buried, and that he rose again the third day according to the scriptures:
verses.fr: qu''il a été enseveli, et qu''il est ressuscité le troisième jour, selon les Ecritures;
verses.am: መጽሐፍም እንደሚል በሦስተኛው ቀን ተነሣ፥

verses.en: And that he was seen of Cephas, then of the twelve:
verses.fr: et qu''il est apparu à Céphas, puis aux douze.
verses.am: ለኬፋም ታየ በኋላም ለአሥራ ሁለቱ፤

verses.en: After that, he was seen of above five hundred brethren at once; of whom the greater part remain unto this present, but some are fallen asleep.
verses.fr: Ensuite, il est apparu à plus de cinq cents frères à la fois, dont la plupart sont encore vivants, et dont quelques-uns sont morts.
verses.am: ከዚያም በኋላ ከአምስት መቶ ለሚበዙ ወንድሞች በአንድ ጊዜ ታየ፤ ከእነርሱም የሚበዙቱ እስከ አሁን አሉ አንዳንዶች ግን አንቀላፍተዋል፤

verses.en: After that, he was seen of James; then of all the apostles.
verses.fr: Ensuite, il est apparu à Jacques, puis à tous les apôtres.
verses.am: ከዚያም በኋላ ለያዕቆብ ኋላም ለሐዋርያት ሁሉ ታየ፤

verses.en: And last of all he was seen of me also, as of one born out of due time.
verses.fr: Après eux tous, il m''est aussi apparu à moi, comme à l''avorton;
verses.am: ከሁሉም በኋላ እንደ ጭንጋፍ ለምሆን ለእኔ ደግሞ ታየኝ።

verses.en: For I am the least of the apostles, that am not meet to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.
verses.fr: car je suis le moindre des apôtres, je ne suis pas digne d''être appelé apôtre, parce que j''ai persécuté l''Eglise de Dieu.
verses.am: እኔ ከሐዋርያት ሁሉ የማንስ ነኝና፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ቤተ ክርስቲያን ስላሳደድሁ ሐዋርያ ተብዬ ልጠራ የማይገባኝ፤

verses.en: But by the grace of God I am what I am: and his grace which was bestowed upon me was not in vain; but I laboured more abundantly than they all: yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.
verses.fr: Par la grâce de Dieu je suis ce que je suis, et sa grâce envers moi n''a pas été vaine; loin de là, j''ai travaillé plus qu''eux tous, non pas moi toutefois, mais la grâce de Dieu qui est avec moi.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በእግዚአብሔር ጸጋ የሆንሁ እኔ ነኝ፤ ለእኔም የተሰጠኝ ጸጋው ከንቱ አልነበረም ከሁላቸው ይልቅ ግን ደከምሁ፥ ዳሩ ግን ከእኔ ጋር ያለው የእግዚአብሔር ጸጋ ነው እንጂ እኔ አይደለሁም።

verses.en: Therefore whether it were I or they, so we preach, and so ye believed.
verses.fr: Ainsi donc, que ce soit moi, que ce soient eux, voilà ce que nous prêchons, et c''est ce que vous avez cru.
verses.am: እንግዲህስ እኔ ብሆን እነርሱም ቢሆኑ እንዲሁ እንሰብካለን እንዲሁም አመናችሁ።

verses.en: Now if Christ be preached that he rose from the dead, how say some among you that there is no resurrection of the dead?
verses.fr: Or, si l''on prêche que Christ est ressuscité des morts, comment quelques-uns parmi vous disent-ils qu''il n''y a point de résurrection des morts?
verses.am: ክርስቶስ ከሙታን እንደ ተነሣ የሚሰበክ ከሆነ ግን ከእናንተ አንዳንዶቹ። ትንሣኤ ሙታን የለም እንዴት ይላሉ?

verses.en: But if there be no resurrection of the dead, then is Christ not risen:
verses.fr: S''il n''y a point de résurrection des morts, Christ non plus n''est pas ressuscité.
verses.am: ትንሣኤ ሙታንስ ከሌለ ክርስቶስ አልተነሣማ፤

verses.en: And if Christ be not risen, then is our preaching vain, and your faith is also vain.
verses.fr: Et si Christ n''est pas ressuscité, notre prédication est donc vaine, et votre foi aussi est vaine.
verses.am: ክርስቶስም ካልተነሣ እንግዲያስ ስብከታችን ከንቱ ነው እምነታችሁም ደግሞ ከንቱ ናት፤

verses.en: Yea, and we are found false witnesses of God; because we have testified of God that he raised up Christ: whom he raised not up, if so be that the dead rise not.
verses.fr: Il se trouve même que nous sommes de faux témoins à l''égard de Dieu, puisque nous avons témoigné contre Dieu qu''il a ressuscité Christ, tandis qu''il ne l''aurait pas ressuscité, si les morts ne ressuscitent point.
verses.am: ደግሞም። ክርስቶስን አስነሥቶታል ብለን በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ስለ መሰከርን ሐሰተኞች የእግዚአብሔር ምስክሮች ሆነን ተገኝተናል፤ ሙታን ግን የማይነሡ ከሆነ እርሱን አላስነሣውም።

verses.en: For if the dead rise not, then is not Christ raised:
verses.fr: Car si les morts ne ressuscitent point, Christ non plus n''est pas ressuscité.
verses.am: ሙታን የማይነሡ ከሆነ ክርስቶስ አልተነሣማ፤

verses.en: And if Christ be not raised, your faith is vain; ye are yet in your sins.
verses.fr: Et si Christ n''est pas ressuscité, votre foi est vaine, vous êtes encore dans vos péchés,
verses.am: ክርስቶስም ካልተነሣ እምነታችሁ ከንቱ ናት፤ እስከ አሁን ድረስ በኃጢአታችሁ አላችሁ።

verses.en: Then they also which are fallen asleep in Christ are perished.
verses.fr: et par conséquent aussi ceux qui sont morts en Christ sont perdus.
verses.am: እንግዲያስ በክርስቶስ ያንቀላፉት ደግሞ ጠፍተዋላ።

verses.en: If in this life only we have hope in Christ, we are of all men most miserable.
verses.fr: Si c''est dans cette vie seulement que nous espérons en Christ, nous sommes les plus malheureux de tous les hommes.
verses.am: በዚች ሕይወት ብቻ ክርስቶስን ተስፋ ያደረግን ከሆነ፥ ከሰው ሁሉ ይልቅ ምስኪኖች ነን።

verses.en: But now is Christ risen from the dead, and become the firstfruits of them that slept.
verses.fr: Mais maintenant, Christ est ressuscité des morts, il est les prémices de ceux qui sont morts.
verses.am: አሁን ግን ክርስቶስ ላንቀላፉት በኩራት ሆኖ ከሙታን ተነሥቶአል።

verses.en: For since by man came death, by man came also the resurrection of the dead.
verses.fr: Car, puisque la mort est venue par un homme, c''est aussi par un homme qu''est venue la résurrection des morts.
verses.am: ሞት በሰው በኩል ስለ መጣ ትንሣኤ ሙታን በሰው በኩል ሆኖአልና።

verses.en: For as in Adam all die, even so in Christ shall all be made alive.
verses.fr: Et comme tous meurent en Adam, de même aussi tous revivront en Christ,
verses.am: ሁሉ በአዳም እንደሚሞቱ እንዲሁ ሁሉ በክርስቶስ ደግሞ ሕያዋን ይሆናሉና።

verses.en: But every man in his own order: Christ the firstfruits; afterward they that are Christ's at his coming.
verses.fr: mais chacun en son rang. Christ comme prémices, puis ceux qui appartiennent à Christ, lors de son avènement.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እያንዳንዱ በራሱ ተራ ይሆናል፤ ክርስቶስ እንደ በኩራት ነው፥ በኋላም በመምጣቱ ለክርስቶስ የሆኑት ናቸው፤

verses.en: Then cometh the end, when he shall have delivered up the kingdom to God, even the Father; when he shall have put down all rule and all authority and power.
verses.fr: Ensuite viendra la fin, quand il remettra le royaume à celui qui est Dieu et Père, après avoir détruit toute domination, toute autorité et toute puissance.
verses.am: በኋላም፥ መንግሥቱን ለእግዚአብሔር ለአባቱ አሳልፎ በሰጠ ጊዜ አለቅነትንም ሁሉና ሥልጣንን ሁሉ ኃይልንም በሻረ ጊዜ፥ ፍጻሜ ይሆናል።

verses.en: For he must reign, till he hath put all enemies under his feet.
verses.fr: Car il faut qu''il règne jusqu''à ce qu''il ait mis tous les ennemis sous ses pieds.
verses.am: ጠላቶቹን ሁሉ ከእግሩ በታች እስኪያደርግ ድረስ ሊነግሥ ይገባዋልና።

verses.en: The last enemy that shall be destroyed is death.
verses.fr: Le dernier ennemi qui sera détruit, c''est la mort.
verses.am: የኋለኛው ጠላት የሚሻረው ሞት ነው፤

verses.en: For he hath put all things under his feet. But when he saith all things are put under him, it is manifest that he is excepted, which did put all things under him.
verses.fr: Dieu, en effet, a tout mis sous ses pieds. Mais lorsqu''il dit que tout lui a été soumis, il est évident que celui qui lui a soumis toutes choses est excepté.
verses.am: ሁሉን ከእግሩ በታች አስገዝቶአልና። ነገር ግን። ሁሉ ተገዝቶአል ሲል፥ ሁሉን ካስገዛለት በቀር መሆኑ ግልጥ ነው።

verses.en: And when all things shall be subdued unto him, then shall the Son also himself be subject unto him that put all things under him, that God may be all in all.
verses.fr: Et lorsque toutes choses lui auront été soumises, alors le Fils lui-même sera soumis à celui qui lui a soumis toutes choses, afin que Dieu soit tout en tous.
verses.am: ሁሉ ከተገዛለት በኋላ ግን እግዚአብሔር ሁሉ በሁሉ ይሆን ዘንድ በዚያን ጊዜ ልጁ ራሱ ደግሞ ሁሉን ላስገዛለት ይገዛል።

verses.en: Else what shall they do which are baptized for the dead, if the dead rise not at all? why are they then baptized for the dead?
verses.fr: Autrement, que feraient ceux qui se font baptiser pour les morts? Si les morts ne ressuscitent absolument pas, pourquoi se font-ils baptiser pour eux?
verses.am: እንዲያማ ካልሆነ፥ ስለ ሙታን የሚጠመቁ ምን ያደርጋሉ? ሙታንስ ከቶ የማይነሡ ከሆነ፥ ስለ እነርሱ የሚጠመቁ ስለ ምንድር ነው?

verses.en: And why stand we in jeopardy every hour?
verses.fr: Et nous, pourquoi sommes-nous à toute heure en péril?
verses.am: እኛስ ዘወትር በሚያስፈራ ኑሮ የምንኖር ስለ ምንድር ነው?

verses.en: I protest by your rejoicing which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.
verses.fr: Chaque jour je suis exposé à la mort, je l''atteste, frères, par la gloire dont vous êtes pour moi le sujet, en Jésus-Christ notre Seigneur.
verses.am: በጌታችን በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ባለኝ በእናንተ ትምክህት እየማልሁ፥ ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ ዕለት ዕለት እሞታለሁ።

verses.en: If after the manner of men I have fought with beasts at Ephesus, what advantageth it me, if the dead rise not? let us eat and drink; for to morrow we die.
verses.fr: Si c''est dans des vues humaines que j''ai combattu contre les bêtes à Ephèse, quel avantage m''en revient-il? Si les morts ne ressuscitent pas, Mangeons et buvons, car demain nous mourrons.
verses.am: እንደ ሰው በኤፌሶን ከአውሬ ጋር ከታገልሁ፥ ሙታንስ የማይነሡ ከሆነ፥ ምን ይጠቅመኛል? ነገ እንሞታለንና እንብላና እንጠጣ።

verses.en: Be not deceived: evil communications corrupt good manners.
verses.fr: Ne vous y trompez pas: les mauvaises compagnies corrompent les bonnes moeurs.
verses.am: አትሳቱ፤ ክፉ ባልንጀርነት መልካሙን አመል ያጠፋል።

verses.en: Awake to righteousness, and sin not; for some have not the knowledge of God: I speak this to your shame.
verses.fr: Revenez à vous-mêmes, comme il est convenable, et ne péchez point; car quelques-uns ne connaissent pas Dieu, je le dis à votre honte.
verses.am: በጽድቅ ንቁ ኃጢአትንም አትሥሩ፤ እግዚአብሔርን የማያውቁ አሉና፤ አሳፍራችሁ ዘንድ ይህን እላለሁ።

verses.en: But some man will say, How are the dead raised up? and with what body do they come?
verses.fr: Mais quelqu''un dira: Comment les morts ressuscitent-ils, et avec quel corps reviennent-ils?
verses.am: ነገር ግን ሰው። ሙታን እንዴት ይነሣሉ? በምንስ ዓይነት አካል ይመጣሉ? የሚል ይኖር ይሆናል።

verses.en: Thou fool, that which thou sowest is not quickened, except it die:
verses.fr: Insensé! ce que tu sèmes ne reprend point vie, s''il ne meurt.
verses.am: አንተ ሞኝ፥ አንተ የምትዘራው ካልሞተ ሕያው አይሆንም፤

verses.en: And that which thou sowest, thou sowest not that body that shall be, but bare grain, it may chance of wheat, or of some other grain:
verses.fr: Et ce que tu sèmes, ce n''est pas le corps qui naîtra; c''est un simple grain, de blé peut-être, ou de quelque autre semence;
verses.am: የምትዘራውም፥ ስንዴ ቢሆን ከሌላም ዓይነት የአንዱ ቢሆን፥ ቅንጣት ብቻ ነው እንጂ የምትዘራው የሚሆነውን አካል አይደለም፤

verses.en: But God giveth it a body as it hath pleased him, and to every seed his own body.
verses.fr: puis Dieu lui donne un corps comme il lui plaît, et à chaque semence il donne un corps qui lui est propre.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ግን እንደ ወደደ አካልን ይሰጠዋል ከዘሮችም ለእያንዳንዱ የገዛ አካሉን ይሰጠዋል።

verses.en: All flesh is not the same flesh: but there is one kind of flesh of men, another flesh of beasts, another of fishes, and another of birds.
verses.fr: Toute chair n''est pas la même chair; mais autre est la chair des hommes, autre celle des quadrupèdes, autre celle des oiseaux, autre celle des poissons.
verses.am: ሥጋ ሁሉ አንድ አይደለም፥ የሰው ሥጋ ግን አንድ ነው፥ የእንስሳም ሥጋ ሌላ ነው፥ የወፎችም ሥጋ ሌላ ነው፥ የዓሣም ሥጋ ሌላ ነው።

verses.en: There are also celestial bodies, and bodies terrestrial: but the glory of the celestial is one, and the glory of the terrestrial is another.
verses.fr: Il y a aussi des corps célestes et des corps terrestres; mais autre est l''éclat des corps célestes, autre celui des corps terrestres.
verses.am: ደግሞ ሰማያዊ አካል አለ፥ ምድራዊም አካል አለ፤ ነገር ግን የሰማያዊ አካል ክብር ልዩ ነው፥ የምድራዊም አካል ክብር ልዩ ነው።

verses.en: There is one glory of the sun, and another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars: for one star differeth from another star in glory.
verses.fr: Autre est l''éclat du soleil, autre l''éclat de la lune, et autre l''éclat des étoiles; même une étoile diffère en éclat d''une autre étoile.
verses.am: የፀሐይ ክብር አንድ ነው የጨረቃም ክብር ሌላ ነው የከዋክብትም ክብር ሌላ ነው፤ በክብር አንዱ ኮከብ ከሌላው ኮከብ ይለያልና።

verses.en: So also is the resurrection of the dead. It is sown in corruption; it is raised in incorruption:
verses.fr: Ainsi en est-il de la résurrection des morts. Le corps est semé corruptible; il ressuscite incorruptible;
verses.am: የሙታን ትንሣኤ ደግሞ እንዲሁ ነው። በመበስበስ ይዘራል፥ ባለመበስበስ ይነሣል፤

verses.en: It is sown in dishonour; it is raised in glory: it is sown in weakness; it is raised in power:
verses.fr: il est semé méprisable, il ressuscite glorieux; il est semé infirme, il ressuscite plein de force;
verses.am: በውርደት ይዘራል፥ በክብር ይነሣል፤ በድካም ይዘራል፥ በኃይል ይነሣል፤

verses.en: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body, and there is a spiritual body.
verses.fr: il est semé corps animal, il ressuscite corps spirituel. S''il y a un corps animal, il y a aussi un corps spirituel.
verses.am: ፍጥረታዊ አካል ይዘራል፥ መንፈሳዊ አካል ይነሣል። ፍጥረታዊ አካል ካለ መንፈሳዊ አካል ደግሞ አለ።

verses.en: And so it is written, The first man Adam was made a living soul; the last Adam was made a quickening spirit.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi il est écrit: Le premier homme, Adam, devint une âme vivante. Le dernier Adam est devenu un esprit vivifiant.
verses.am: እንዲሁ ደግሞ። ፊተኛው ሰው አዳም ሕያው ነፍስ ሆነ ተብሎ ተጽፎአል፤ ኋለኛው አዳም ሕይወትን የሚሰጥ መንፈስ ሆነ።

verses.en: Howbeit that was not first which is spiritual, but that which is natural; and afterward that which is spiritual.
verses.fr: Mais ce qui est spirituel n''est pas le premier, c''est ce qui est animal; ce qui est spirituel vient ensuite.
verses.am: ነገር ግን አስቀድሞ ፍጥረታዊው ቀጥሎም መንፈሳዊው ነው እንጂ መንፈሳዊው መጀመሪያ አይደለም።

verses.en: The first man is of the earth, earthy; the second man is the Lord from heaven.
verses.fr: Le premier homme, tiré de la terre, est terrestre; le second homme est du ciel.
verses.am: የፊተኛው ሰው ከመሬት መሬታዊ ነው፤ ሁለተኛው ሰው ከሰማይ ነው።

verses.en: As is the earthy, such are they also that are earthy: and as is the heavenly, such are they also that are heavenly.
verses.fr: Tel est le terrestre, tels sont aussi les terrestres; et tel est le céleste, tels sont aussi les célestes.
verses.am: መሬታዊው እንደ ሆነ መሬታውያን የሆኑት ደግሞ እንዲሁ ናቸው፥ ሰማያዊው እንደ ሆነ ሰማያውያን የሆኑት ደግሞ እንዲሁ ናቸው።

verses.en: And as we have borne the image of the earthy, we shall also bear the image of the heavenly.
verses.fr: Et de même que nous avons porté l''image du terrestre, nous porterons aussi l''image du céleste.
verses.am: የዚያንም የመሬታዊውን መልክ እንደ ለበስን የሰማያዊውን መልክ ደግሞ እንለብሳለን።

verses.en: Now this I say, brethren, that flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of God; neither doth corruption inherit incorruption.
verses.fr: Ce que je dis, frères, c''est que la chair et le sang ne peuvent hériter le royaume de Dieu, et que la corruption n''hérite pas l''incorruptibilité.
verses.am: ነገር ግን፥ ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ ይህን እላለሁ። ሥጋና ደም የእግዚአብሔርን መንግሥት ሊወርሱ አይችሉም፥ የሚበሰብሰውም የማይበሰብሰውን አይወርስም።

verses.en: Behold, I shew you a mystery; We shall not all sleep, but we shall all be changed,
verses.fr: Voici, je vous dis un mystère: nous ne mourrons pas tous, mais tous nous serons changés,
verses.am: ይህ የሚበሰብሰው የማይበሰብሰውን ሊለብስ ይህም የሚሞተው የማይሞተውን ሊለብስ ይገባዋልና።

verses.en: In a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trump: for the trumpet shall sound, and the dead shall be raised incorruptible, and we shall be changed.
verses.fr: en un instant, en un clin d''oeil, à la dernière trompette. La trompette sonnera, et les morts ressusciteront incorruptibles, et nous, nous serons changés.
verses.am: ይህ የሚበሰብሰው የማይበሰብሰውን ሊለብስ ይህም የሚሞተው የማይሞተውን ሊለብስ ይገባዋልና።

verses.en: For this corruptible must put on incorruption, and this mortal must put on immortality.
verses.fr: Car il faut que ce corps corruptible revête l''incorruptibilité, et que ce corps mortel revête l''immortalité.
verses.am: ዳሩ ግን ይህ የሚበሰብሰው የማይበሰብሰውን ሲለብስ ይህም የሚሞተው የማይሞተውን ሲለብስ፥ በዚያን ጊዜ። ሞት ድል በመነሣት ተዋጠ ተብሎ የተጻፈው ቃል ይፈጸማል።

verses.en: So when this corruptible shall have put on incorruption, and this mortal shall have put on immortality, then shall be brought to pass the saying that is written, Death is swallowed up in victory.
verses.fr: Lorsque ce corps corruptible aura revêtu l''incorruptibilité, et que ce corps mortel aura revêtu l''immortalité, alors s''accomplira la parole qui est écrite: La mort a été engloutie dans la victoire.
verses.am: ሞት ሆይ፥ መውጊያህ የት አለ? ሲኦል ሆይ፥ ድል መንሣትህ የት አለ?

verses.en: O death, where is thy sting? O grave, where is thy victory?
verses.fr: O mort, où est ta victoire? O mort, où est ton aiguillon?
verses.am: የሞት መውጊያ ኃጢአት ነው የኃጢአትም ኃይል ሕግ ነው፤

verses.en: The sting of death is sin; and the strength of sin is the law.
verses.fr: L''aiguillon de la mort, c''est le péché; et la puissance du péché, c''est la loi.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በጌታችን በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ በኩል ድል መንሣትን ለሚሰጠን ለእግዚአብሔር ምስጋና ይሁን።

verses.en: But thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.fr: Mais grâces soient rendues à Dieu, qui nous donne la victoire par notre Seigneur Jésus-Christ!
verses.am: ስለዚህ፥ የተወደዳችሁ ወንድሞቼ ሆይ፥ ድካማችሁ በጌታ ከንቱ እንዳይሆን አውቃችኋልና የምትደላደሉ፥ የማትነቃነቁም፥ የጌታም ሥራ ሁልጊዜ የሚበዛላችሁ ሁኑ።

verses.en: Therefore, my beloved brethren, be ye stedfast, unmoveable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord.
verses.fr: Ainsi, mes frères bien-aimés, soyez fermes, inébranlables, travaillant de mieux en mieux à l''oeuvre du Seigneur, sachant que votre travail ne sera pas vain dans le Seigneur.
verses.am: ስለዚህ፥ የተወደዳችሁ ወንድሞቼ ሆይ፥ ድካማችሁ በጌታ ከንቱ እንዳይሆን አውቃችኋልና የምትደላደሉ፥ የማትነቃነቁም፥ የጌታም ሥራ ሁልጊዜ የሚበዛላችሁ ሁኑ።

verses.en: Now concerning the collection for the saints, as I have given order to the churches of Galatia, even so do ye.
verses.fr: Pour ce qui concerne la collecte en faveur des saints, agissez, vous aussi, comme je l''ai ordonné aux Eglises de la Galatie.
verses.am: ለቅዱሳንም ገንዘብን ስለ ማዋጣት፥ ለገላትያ አብያተ ክርስቲያናት እንደ ደነገግሁት እናንተ ደግሞ እንዲሁ አድርጉ።

verses.en: Upon the first day of the week let every one of you lay by him in store, as God hath prospered him, that there be no gatherings when I come.
verses.fr: Que chacun de vous, le premier jour de la semaine, mette à part chez lui ce qu''il pourra, selon sa prospérité, afin qu''on n''attende pas mon arrivée pour recueillir les dons.
verses.am: እኔ ስመጣ ይህ የገንዘብ ማዋጣት ያን ጊዜ እንዳይሆን፥ ከእናንተ እያንዳንዱ በየሳምንቱ በፊተኛው ቀን እንደ ቀናው መጠን እያስቀረ በቤቱ ያስቀምጥ።

verses.en: And when I come, whomsoever ye shall approve by your letters, them will I send to bring your liberality unto Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Et quand je serai venu, j''enverrai avec des lettres, pour porter vos libéralités à Jérusalem, les personnes que vous aurez approuvées.
verses.am: ስመጣም ማናቸውም ቢሆኑ የታመኑ የሚመስሉአችሁ ሰዎች ቸርነታችሁን ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ያደርሱ ዘንድ ደብዳቤ ሰጥቼ እልካቸዋለሁ፤

verses.en: And if it be meet that I go also, they shall go with me.
verses.fr: Si la chose mérite que j''y aille moi-même, elles feront le voyage avec moi.
verses.am: እኔ ደግሞ ልሄድ የሚገባኝ ብሆን ከእኔ ጋር አብረው ይሄዳሉ።

verses.en: Now I will come unto you, when I shall pass through Macedonia: for I do pass through Macedonia.
verses.fr: J''irai chez vous quand j''aurai traversé la Macédoine, car je traverserai la Macédoine.
verses.am: በመቄዶንያም ሳልፍ ወደ እናንተ እመጣለሁ፤ በመቄዶንያ አድርጌ አልፋለሁና፤

verses.en: And it may be that I will abide, yea, and winter with you, that ye may bring me on my journey whithersoever I go.
verses.fr: Peut-être séjournerai-je auprès de vous, ou même y passerai-je l''hiver, afin que vous m''accompagniez là où je me rendrai.
verses.am: እናንተም ወደምሄድበት ወደ ማናቸውም ስፍራ በጉዞዬ እንድትረዱኝ ምናልባት በእናንተ ዘንድ እቆይ ወይም እከርም ይሆናል።

verses.en: For I will not see you now by the way; but I trust to tarry a while with you, if the Lord permit.
verses.fr: Je ne veux pas cette fois vous voir en passant, mais j''espère demeurer quelque temps auprès de vous, si le Seigneur le permet.
verses.am: አሁን እግረ መንገዴን ሳልፍ ልጎበኛችሁ አልወድምና፤ ጌታ ቢፈቅደው የሆነውን ዘመን በእናንተ ዘንድ ልሰነብት ተስፋ አደርጋለሁና።

verses.en: But I will tarry at Ephesus until Pentecost.
verses.fr: Je resterai néanmoins à Ephèse jusqu''à la Pentecôte;
verses.am: በኤፌሶን ግን እስከ በዓለ ኀምሳ ድረስ እሰነብታለሁ።

verses.en: For a great door and effectual is opened unto me, and there are many adversaries.
verses.fr: car une porte grande et d''un accès efficace m''est ouverte, et les adversaires sont nombreux.
verses.am: ሥራ የሞላበት ትልቅ በር ተከፍቶልኛልና ተቃዋሚዎችም ብዙ ናቸው።

verses.en: Now if Timotheus come, see that he may be with you without fear: for he worketh the work of the Lord, as I also do.
verses.fr: Si Timothée arrive, faites en sorte qu''il soit sans crainte parmi vous, car il travaille comme moi à l''oeuvre du Seigneur.
verses.am: ጢሞቴዎስም የመጣ እንደ ሆነ በእናንተ ዘንድ ያለ ፍርሃት እንዲኖር ተጠንቀቁ፤ እንደ እኔ ደግሞ የጌታን ሥራ ይሠራልና፤ እንግዲህ ማንም አይናቀው።

verses.en: Let no man therefore despise him: but conduct him forth in peace, that he may come unto me: for I look for him with the brethren.
verses.fr: Que personne donc ne le méprise. Accompagnez-le en paix, afin qu''il vienne vers moi, car je l''attends avec les frères.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ከወንድሞቹ ጋር እጠብቀዋለሁና ወደ እኔ ይመጣ ዘንድ በሰላም በጉዞው እርዱት።

verses.en: As touching our brother Apollos, I greatly desired him to come unto you with the brethren: but his will was not at all to come at this time; but he will come when he shall have convenient time.
verses.fr: Pour ce qui est du frère Apollos, je l''ai beaucoup exhorté à se rendre chez vous avec les frères, mais ce n''était décidément pas sa volonté de le faire maintenant; il partira quand il en aura l''occasion.
verses.am: ስለ ወንድማችን ስለ አጵሎስ ግን ከወንድሞቹ ጋር ወደ እናንተ ሊሄድ እጅግ አድርጌ ለምኜው ነበር፤ ዛሬም ለመምጣት ከቶ ፈቃድ አልነበረውም፥ ሲመቸው ግን ይመጣል።

verses.en: Watch ye, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be strong.
verses.fr: Veillez, demeurez fermes dans la foi, soyez des hommes, fortifiez-vous.
verses.am: ንቁ፥ በሃይማኖት ቁሙ፥ ጎልምሱ ጠንክሩ።

verses.en: Let all your things be done with charity.
verses.fr: Que tout ce que vous faites se fasse avec charité!
verses.am: በእናንተ ዘንድ ሁሉ በፍቅር ይሁን።

verses.en: I beseech you, brethren, (ye know the house of Stephanas, that it is the firstfruits of Achaia, and that they have addicted themselves to the ministry of the saints,)
verses.fr: Encore une recommandation que je vous adresse, frères. Vous savez que la famille de Stéphanas est les prémices de l''Achaïe, et qu''elle s''est dévouée au service des saints.
verses.am: ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ የእስጢፋኖስ ቤተ ሰዎች የአካይያ በኩራት እንደ ሆኑ ቅዱሳንንም ለማገልገል ራሳቸውን እንደ ሰጡ ታውቃላችሁ፤

verses.en: That ye submit yourselves unto such, and to every one that helpeth with us, and laboureth.
verses.fr: Ayez vous aussi de la déférence pour de tels hommes, et pour tous ceux qui travaillent à la même oeuvre.
verses.am: እንደ እነርሱ ላሉትና አብሮ ለሚሠራ ለሚደክምም ሁሉ እናንተም እንድትገዙ እለምናችኋለሁ።

verses.en: I am glad of the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus: for that which was lacking on your part they have supplied.
verses.fr: Je me réjouis de la présence de Stéphanas, de Fortunatus et d''Achaïcus; ils ont suppléé à votre absence,
verses.am: በእስጢፋኖስና በፈርዶናጥስ በአካይቆስም መምጣት ደስ ይለኛል፥ እናንተ ስለሌላችሁ የጎደለኝን ፈጽመዋልና፤ መንፈሴንና መንፈሳችሁን አሳርፈዋልና።

verses.en: For they have refreshed my spirit and yours: therefore acknowledge ye them that are such.
verses.fr: car ils ont tranquillisé mon esprit et le vôtre. Sachez donc apprécier de tels hommes.
verses.am: እንግዲህ እንደነዚህ ያሉትን እወቁአቸው።

verses.en: The churches of Asia salute you. Aquila and Priscilla salute you much in the Lord, with the church that is in their house.
verses.fr: Les Eglises d''Asie vous saluent. Aquilas et Priscille, avec l''Eglise qui est dans leur maison, vous saluent beaucoup dans le Seigneur.
verses.am: የእስያ አብያተ ክርስቲያናት ሰላምታ ያቀርቡላችኋል። አቂላና ጵርስቅላ በቤታቸው ካለች ቤተ ክርስቲያን ጋር በጌታ እጅግ ሰላምታ ያቀርቡላችኋል።

verses.en: All the brethren greet you. Greet ye one another with an holy kiss.
verses.fr: Tous les frères vous saluent. Saluez-vous les uns les autres par un saint baiser.
verses.am: ወንድሞች ሁሉ ሰላምታ ያቀርቡላችኋል። በተቀደሰ አሳሳም እርስ በርሳችሁ ሰላምታ ተሰጣጡ።

verses.en: The salutation of me Paul with mine own hand.
verses.fr: Je vous salue, moi Paul, de ma propre main.
verses.am: እኔ ጳውሎስ ይህን ሰላምታ በገዛ እጄ ጽፌአለሁ።

verses.en: If any man love not the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be Anathema Maranatha.
verses.fr: Si quelqu''un n''aime pas le Seigneur, qu''il soit anathème! Maranatha.
verses.am: ጌታን ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስን የማይወድ ቢኖር የተረገመ ይሁን። ጌታችን ሆይ፥ ና።

verses.en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
verses.fr: Que la grâce du Seigneur Jésus soit avec vous!
verses.am: የጌታ የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ጸጋ ከእናንተ ጋር ይሁን።

verses.en: My love be with you all in Christ Jesus. Amen.
verses.fr: Mon amour est avec vous tous en Jésus-Christ.
verses.am: ፍቅሬ በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ከሁላችሁ ጋር ነው። አሜን።
